reason: Conversation 2 is more efficient, asking targeted questions (freezer temperature, frost) and giving UK-appropriate units, then it explains clearly that a manual defrost is only a temporary fix and that an engineer should test the defrost heater, sensor and control rather than replace parts blindly. Conversation 1 is also safe and reaches the right diagnosis with a good warning about not chipping ice, but it is longer, uses US units and mentions GFCI, and asserts that the scraping is 'likely the fan hitting ice' more confidently than the evidence supports. Neither conversation asks for the full model number, and neither makes unsupported part claims.
